articles.title: France prepares for day of protest a week after nationwide riots
articles.description: More than 70,000 police officers are to be deployed over fears protesters will defy restrictions on demonstrations.

articles.title: Woman, 65, becomes second patient to die of Ebola in Kenya
articles.description: She was a close family member of the first victim, a man who had travelled from the Democratic Republic of Congo.

articles.title: Arrest made after fire at Hitler's Eagle's Nest retreat
articles.description: Around 200 emergency personnel are deployed to fight the blaze at the Nazi dictator's Alpine residence in Germany.
